prompt: Of the non-Americans who have won the Phoenix Open as of 2024, who was the youngest at the time of his win?
answer: Aaron Baddeley of Australia was the youngest non-American Phoenix Open winner as of 2024. He was **25 years, 10 months, and 28 days old** when he won the 2007 Phoenix Open.
